'''Márcio Costa Macêdo''' (born 18 September 1970) is a Brazilian politician serving as [[Office of the President of Brazil|secretary-general of the presidency]] since 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.gov.br/secretariageral/pt-br/noticias/2023/janeiro/marcio-macedo-assume-secretaria-geral-da-presidencia-com-portas-abertas-ao-povo|title=Márcio Macêdo assume Secretaria-Geral da Presidência com portas abertas ao povo|publisher=[[Federal government of Brazil]]|date=3 January 2023|language=pt}}</ref> He was a member of the [[Chamber of Deputies (Brazil)|Chamber of Deputies]] from 2011 to 2015 and from 2022 to 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.camara.leg.br/deputados/160542/biografia|title=Márcio Macêdo|publisher=[[Chamber of Deputies (Brazil)|Chamber of Deputies]]|language=pt}}</ref>
